paper.title: DrugSAGE:Self-evolving Agent Experience for Efficient State-of-the-Art Drug Discovery
paper.central_claim: 跨任务持久化已验证技能、性能/编辑经验与执行修复，条件化MCTS或零搜索路由，在33分子预测任务及17留出目标上以更低搜索成本达到SOTA。

provenance.notes: 当前环境声明gpt-6.1-sol；无独立runtime receipt/session标识，不探测。盲评仅本席输出，未读前两篇记录。

sections_read: Appendices A–J（含全部任务表、baseline prompts、routing案例与regret证明）

evidence.quote: Critically, most of the existing agents pay for this full cost independently on every new task, discarding all search experience before the next one begins.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者具体 gap：新任务重做搜索；不是模型权重训练贡献。

evidence.quote: Each record in this memory describes a node in the search tree, including its model family, model architecture, hyperparameters, training procedure, data processing, training objectives, task description, and its performance on the validation set.
evidence.support_explanation: 非权重 solution case 持久化和验证来源；refinement/execution 分别保存编辑差值与可验证修复。

evidence.quote: The generated edit must parse into the expected schema and pass duplicate and feasibility checks.
evidence.support_explanation: 候选格式/重复/可行性门控；后续将真实结果写回。

evidence.quote: Successful fixes are marked verified; the final status, metrics, logs, resource trace, and repair outcome are written back to
evidence.support_explanation: 修复经执行认证并持久化，下一任务按错误签名读出，不等于改进器自改。

evidence.quote: These 11 Polaris tasks form a separate held-out benchmark set used only at evaluation time and never entering
evidence.support_explanation: 16个源任务、6个TDC及11个Polaris目标隔离的明示协议；尚非分子级去重审计。

evidence.quote: All agents selects best solutions by validation performance and we report the average test metrics.
evidence.support_explanation: 验证选解、测试报告，官方五seed、native metric支持测量。

evidence.quote: the normalized score increases monotonically, while the cost decreases monotonically, showing that the gain is not only from the base search procedure but also from reusing experience across tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 无memory、仅execution、full memory 控制支持记忆归因，缺细分R/H和朴素固定强解迁移对照。

evidence.quote: In summary, these results show that experience accumulated on the historical tasks transfers to held-out tasks and can provide a high-quality solution for related problems without test-time search.
evidence.support_explanation: 结果声明：跨任务留存收益；表2/8提供各任务绝对指标与5seed标准差。

evidence.quote: Each experiment is run on a single NVIDIA L40S GPU, wall-clock budget per agent per task is capped at 24 hours.
evidence.support_explanation: 硬件及时间上限明确，但offline16源任务与skill构建摊销、全部修复GPU成本无总账。

claims.text: 跨任务记忆可替代新目标搜索并获高分。
claims.baseline_control: 八类agent B≤20及TDC参考；本法memory-off/Q/full与analog移除
claims.selection_vs_test: 源库与目标分离，目标validation选解test汇报；zero按元数据不按target分数路由
claims.result: 作者报TDC norm .90 / Polaris .97；Solubility MAE .686±.006；LD50 .547±.010弱于full .502±.013。
claims.denominator: 17目标，5seed训练/评测；不是5次完整agent搜索
counterevidence: 朴素强配方迁移、同source曝光基线缺
claims.allowed_conclusion: 限定分子任务source→target的author-reported retained transfer，不是普遍自主科学或improver改进。

claims.text: 显著降低成本并保留UCB regret阶。
claims.setting: task API成本及B budget；Appendix J理论
claims.selection_vs_test: offline K/Z构建不在zero test API
claims.result: 零目标搜索不等于零训练；理论仅adjusted reward且需额外一致性/optimism。
claims.denominator: 六TDC成本图；源任务16次构建未摊销
counterevidence: 正文有界prior不独自推出原始reward的regret保证
claims.allowed_conclusion: 可报告目标搜索/API下降及附条件adjusted-reward分析，不能声称全生命周期近零成本或无条件原始regret不变。

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: 作者报告，在固定药物性质任务划分中跨任务保留的非权重经验支持留出配方迁移和更低目标搜索/API成本，memory-off控制支持部分归因；非我们复现。
unresolved: 全生命周期成本、跨搜索方差与朴素跨任务迁移基线
理论结论需缩限到附加假设的adjusted reward

G.reason: 具体昂贵试错与跨任务经验丢弃，谱系含Agentomics/ML agents及agent memory；邻居只经本文描述核对，未能独立验证残余。

M.reason: R/H/Q按性能先验、typed edit、错误修复分治，公式和B=0路由可重建；相似任务与策略可迁移假设仍启发式，regret只覆盖adjusted reward。

X.reason: 技能多级执行门控、去重复、validation选择、持久化后路由明确；未完整规定长期冲突、失效淘汰/版本回滚。

E.measurement.reason: 官方TDC/Polaris原生指标、绝对结果和统一评测脚本可信；min-max相对增益不能当物理/临床收益，图内部分ablation数值未抽取。

E.causality.reason: memory-off/仅Q/full、anchor和同类移除有针对性；无固定强配方或同源数据简单检索迁移对照，offline信息暴露和不同backbone基线未完全匹配。

E.holdout.reason: 16构建任务与17目标任务分开、validation选解test汇报，Polaris不入库；未有分子重叠/基础模型预训练污染审计。

E.statistics.reason: 绝对指标mean±std五seed并报告LD50负例，但未报告跨完整agent搜索seed/顺序方差、CI或显著性检验；按A2不升3。

E.cost.reason: API成本对照、B映射及单L40S/24h已报；零搜索不是零训练，未核算源库与skills构建摊销和全失败修复实际成本。

reason: 固定全文含A–J附录完整，范围内A类非权重经验留存；核心可评分，成本/理论宽主张按证据限缩。
rationale: 跨任务R/H/Q复用与17目标隔离提供留存证据；缺简单强配方迁移、全成本及跨搜索统计，regret只在附条件adjusted reward成立。
